bms_g_4139_20000117.name: bms_pb11_trigger_phase
bms_g_4139_20000117.description: Step counter of the PB11 trigger sequence run by bms_pb11_trigger_sequence_step (4130 and 4139 builds). It is set to 0 (stopped) whenever bit 5 of the state byte at +0x194 is clear. While the sequence runs, step 0 runs the dual-bank step with argument 0 and moves to 1; step 1 runs it with argument 1 and moves to 2 once the flag at 0x20000112 is 1 (then it starts USART3 TX, arms EXTI line 11 and writes record 0x2C); step 2 waits for the PB11 hold or a bit-10 condition, disarms EXTI line 11 and returns to 0. The meanings of the steps are inferred from the code. Only this routine accesses the byte in this packet.

bms_g_4168_20000564.name: bms_pd0_blink_timer
bms_g_4168_20000564.description: Period counter for the PD0 indicator pattern, advanced by bms_pd0_indicator_step (4130 to 4168 builds). Each call adds the signed elapsed-ticks parameter param_5 (probably 1 ms per tick). The sum is compared with the thresholds of the selected pattern (from 100 up to 4000 ticks); while below the period end it keeps counting, and when the period ends the routine drives PD0 and clears the counter to 0. Type is a guess: probably s16, inferred from the signed 16-bit addend. Whether PD0 drives an active-high LED or a buzzer is not established.
